module: Flowgraph node "Get Crawl Data" (category repeat_instant, crawl). Reads the runtime data of the active crawl via the bridge. Outputs: onCompleted, onDisqualified, onCheckpointReached (flow on edge), isCompleted, disqualified, crawlerPosition (vec3), crawlerDirection (quat, yaw only), vehicleId, hasRecoveryCheckpoint, recoveryPosition, recoveryRotation. Without an active crawl: node error and null default values ({0,0,0}, {0,0,0,1}).

init.desc: Loads the bridge and initializes the last states (completed, disqualified, checkpoint index).

work.desc: Calls bridge.getCrawlRuntimeData and getLastRecoveryCheckpoint, detects state changes and fills the pins.
